mode.description: "local" for self-hosted Cognee, "cloud" for Cognee Cloud (default: local). Also settable via COGNEE_MODE env var. Cloud mode supports: add, search, cognify, delete. Update (modifying existing data) is not yet supported — use the Cognee Cloud platform or API directly.

baseUrl.description: Cognee API base URL (default: http://localhost:8011). Also settable via COGNEE_BASE_URL env var.

password.description: Cognee login password (default: default_password). Together with username this selects which user the plugin logs in as; a non-default user must already exist on the server. The local server the plugin starts always creates the default user with default_password (via DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD) unless you export DEFAULT_USER_EMAIL / DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD yourself. An external server (cognee >= 1.6.0) must itself be started with DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD set, or use an API key (apiKey / COGNEE_API_KEY) instead.

datasetName.description: Cognee dataset name for single-scope mode (default: agent_sessions). Also settable via COGNEE_PLUGIN_DATASET env var. Ignored when multi-scope is enabled.

companyDataset.description: Dataset name for company-wide shared memory. Setting this enables multi-scope mode.

userDatasetPrefix.description: Prefix for user-scoped datasets (becomes '{prefix}-{userId}'). Setting this enables multi-scope mode.

agentDatasetPrefix.description: Prefix for agent-scoped datasets (becomes '{prefix}-{agentId}'). Setting this enables multi-scope mode.

agentDatasetTemplate.description: Template for the per-agent dataset name with '{agentId}' placeholder (e.g. '{agentId}' for bare id, 'memory-{agentId}' for prefixed). Takes precedence over agentDatasetPrefix when set. Enables multi-scope mode.

perAgentMemory.description: Give each agent its own dataset. Strictly opt-in; only takes effect together with agentDatasetPrefix or agentDatasetTemplate (default: false)

userId.description: User identifier for user-scoped memory (or set OPENCLAW_USER_ID env var)

agentId.description: Agent identifier for agent-scoped memory (or set OPENCLAW_AGENT_ID env var, default: 'default')

recallScopes.description: Memory scopes to search during recall, in priority order (default: ['agent', 'user', 'company'])

defaultWriteScope.description: Default scope for files that don't match any scopeRouting pattern (default: 'agent')

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths (e.g. 'memory/company/**')

scopeRouting.description: Rules to route memory files to scopes based on path patterns. First match wins.

enableSessions.description: Enable session-based conversation tracking for multi-turn recall (default: true)

persistSessionsAfterEnd.description: Persist session Q&A pairs into the knowledge graph after agent ends (default: true)

captureSession.description: Capture each tool call as a trace entry and each prompt/answer pair as a QA entry in Cognee's session cache (default: true; requires enableSessions)

captureTools.description: Tools whose calls are captured: names, fnmatch globs, or Tool(prefix:*) matched against a shell command's first word; case-insensitive (default: COGNEE_CAPTURE_TOOLS, else all)

captureDenyTools.description: Tools never captured, same pattern forms as captureTools (default: COGNEE_CAPTURE_DENY_TOOLS, else none)

captureDenyPaths.description: Extra file globs whose tool calls are never captured, added to the built-in list (.env*, *.pem, *.key, ssh and cloud credentials, secrets.*, credentials.*) (default: COGNEE_CAPTURE_DENY_PATHS)

captureRedact.description: Scrub secrets (private keys, tokens, DB URLs, credential assignments, vendor keys) from captured prompts, answers and tool calls (default: COGNEE_CAPTURE_REDACT, else true)

captureRedactPatterns.description: Extra regular expressions whose matches are redacted (default: COGNEE_CAPTURE_REDACT_PATTERNS)

searchType.description: Cognee search mode (default: HYBRID_COMPLETION — combined vector + graph retrieval)

deleteMode.description: Cognee delete mode: 'soft' removes raw data only, 'hard' also removes degree-one graph nodes (default: soft)

maxResults.description: Max recall results to inject per scope (default: 6)

minScore.description: Minimum score to include in recall (default: 0)

maxTokens.description: Deprecated, no effect: recall is bounded by recallPassageChars and recallContextChars. Kept so existing configs keep validating

recallPassageChars.description: Cap per recalled passage, cut at a paragraph break; 0 disables (default: COGNEE_RECALL_PASSAGE_CHARS, else 2000)

recallContextChars.description: Cap on everything one prompt injects (graph context, guidance, code facts); each dataset's context drops whole passages from the end to fit, and the block that crosses the total is cut and marked; 0 disables (default: COGNEE_RECALL_CONTEXT_CHARS, else 12000)

recallInjectionPosition.description: Where recalled memories are injected: prepend to system prompt, append to system prompt, or prepend to prompt context (default: prependSystemContext)

autoRecall.description: Inject memories before each agent run (default: true)

codeSearchTool.description: Register the memory_code_search agent tool for deterministic structural queries against repositories indexed with `openclaw cognee index-repo` (default: true)

recapTool.description: Register the memory_recap agent tool: a standup, digest or topic timeline built from the sessions Cognee recorded (default: true)

codeGraphRecall.description: Add a deterministic code-graph recall lane when a prompt names an identifier and at least one code graph is indexed or listed in codeDatasets (default: true)

codeDatasets.description: Extra code-graph dataset names to query in addition to repositories indexed on this machine

memorySteer.description: Append a static system-prompt line on each agent run asserting Cognee as the preferred long-term memory and naming the memory tools (default: true)

recallSessionLayers.description: Deprecated, no effect: recall fetches the graph context and this session's guidance itself. Kept so existing configs keep validating

memoryTools.description: Register the memory_search / memory_get agent tools OpenClaw's memory slot expects (used by active-memory). Independent of autoRecall (default: true)

memoryForgetTool.description: Also register the memory_forget agent tool: user-directed deletion of individual documents, two-phase (find candidates, then forget listed data ids with confirm=true). Whole-dataset wipes stay CLI-only. Requires Cognee >= 1.5.3 (default: true)

datasetSwitchTool.description: Also register the memory_switch_dataset agent tool: move one conversation to another dataset (list / current / switch / reset). Syncs the current session first; later capture, recall and session-end improve for that conversation target the new dataset (default: true)

improveOnSessionEnd.description: On session_end, call /improve with the session id to bridge session-cache QAs into the permanent graph (default: true)

memoryHitFooter.description: Append a one-line footer to the agent's final reply on turns where auto-recall injected at least one memory, e.g. "[cognee: 3 memories]". No footer on turns without hits (default: true)

weeklyDigest.description: Once per 7 days, append a digest to the agent's next reply with turns-with-hits, total turns and top memory sources. Suppressed when the week had zero hits (default: true)

noiseTriggers.description: ctx.trigger values treated as harness turns, excluded from auto-recall and capture. [] disables this layer (default: ["heartbeat", "cron"])

noisePatterns.description: Regexes matched against the prompt (leading whitespace stripped) to catch harness templates; matching prompts are excluded from auto-recall and capture. Replaces the defaults when set; [] disables this layer

autoIndex.description: Auto-sync memory files to Cognee on plugin startup (default: true)

autoCognify.description: Run cognify after new memories are added (default: true)

autoMemify.description: Run memify (graph enrichment) after cognify completes (default: false)

recallTimeoutMs.description: Per recall HTTP call timeout on the prompt path, no retries (default: 20000)

recallBudgetMs.description: Overall wall-clock budget for the recall step per prompt; when exceeded the turn proceeds without memories (default: 20000)

recallBreakerThreshold.description: Consecutive recall failures (network/timeout/5xx) before recall is temporarily skipped (default: 5)

recallBreakerCooldownMs.description: How long recall is skipped after the breaker opens (default: 120000)

requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for Cognee requests (default: 60000)

ingestionTimeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for add/update (ingestion) requests (default: 300000 = 5 min)

chunkSize.description: Maximum tokens per chunk when syncing memory files, sent to Cognee as chunk_size. Keep it under your embedding model's input limit. Unset: the server default (4096). Not applied to files updated in place

searchPrompt.description: System prompt sent to Cognee to guide search query processing (default: '')
